latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Add padding around text layer to compensate for buggy fonts by @eXCoreX in https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-ios/pull/2639
* Add staticRendering mode for snapshot testing by @jqsilver in https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-ios/pull/2642
* Fix animation state lost when view removed from window in SwiftUI by @kirillsh in https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-ios/pull/2646
* Fix currentFrame rounding by @Med1D in https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-ios/pull/2650
* Add Objective-C compatible font provider to CompatibleAnimationView. by @dzhu7 in https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-ios/pull/2657
* Main-thread NodeRenderSystem performance improvement by @ChrisBenua in https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-ios/pull/2663
* Fix division by zero in GradientValueProvider with single color by @04cb in https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-ios/pull/2664
* Add Objective-C compatible image provider by @Seungwan98 in https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-ios/pull/2660
* NSSet -> Set, add Hashable by @ladd in https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-ios/pull/2659
* Fix incorrect mask animation timing on precomp layers by @RohitMaru in https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-ios/pull/2676
* Value Providers Not Working Correctly When Setting Gradient Colors by @dinozaurus0 in https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-ios/pull/2677
* Recognize the IANA `.lot` extension as a Lottie JSON alias by @tsushanth in https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-ios/pull/2688
* Update embedded ZIPFoundation to 0.9.20 to prevent symlink path traversal during ZIP extraction by @rm335 in https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-ios/pull/2689
* Don't fail decoding when text font 'ascent' or line height ('lh') is missing by @fanmingyi in https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-ios/pull/2690

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-ios/compare/4.6.0...4.6.1
